### Ameriprise Financial Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/618704162/files/doc_news/Ameriprise-Financial-Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) today announced its third quarter 2026 results via an earnings release available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[https://ir.ameriprise.com/financials/quarterly-results/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2F&esheet=54630802&newsitemid=20261028285965&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2F&index=1&md5=2292ddbeaf30e1732d8be8f6b044848f) .


Management will host an investor conference call to review the results at approximately 9 a.m. (ET) today. Live audio of the conference call, presentation slides and an audio replay will be available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[ir.ameriprise.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54630802&newsitemid=20261028285965&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.ameriprise.com&index=2&md5=59540979bbbe055b4fc24b1328cf381d) .


At Ameriprise Financial, we have been helping people feel confident about their financial future for more than 130 years. With extensive investment advice, global asset management capabilities and insurance solutions, and a nationwide network of more than 10,000 financial advisors, we have the strength and expertise to serve the full range of individual and institutional investors' financial needs.
